gloss: go-home club (humorous term for not being in any club)

definitions.gloss: go-home club; students who don't belong to any club
definitions.explanation: A humorous, self-deprecating term used by Japanese students who are not members of any extracurricular club or team. Structured like a real club name but meaning they simply go straight home after school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{僕|ぼく}→僕：01729_boku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{帰宅部|きたくぶ}です。
examples.english: I'm in the go-home club (I'm not in any club).

examples.japanese: ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ら→入る：00494_hairu⟧ず{帰宅部|きたくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose the go-home club instead of joining an extracurricular activity.

examples.japanese: {帰宅部|きたくぶ}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごしていた→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: Since I was in the go-home club, I spent my time after school however I wanted.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, extracurricular club activities (⟦{部活動|ぶかつどう}→部活動：14539_bukatsudou⟧) are a major part of student life, and there is social pressure to belong to one. {帰宅部|きたくぶ} is a humorous coinage that treats "going home" as if it were an official club, using the standard ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ suffix found in real club names like ⟦{野球部|やきゅうぶ}→野球部：27441_yakyuubu⟧ or ⟦{美術部|びじゅつぶ}→美術部：27442_bijutsubu⟧.

USAGE:
Mainly used by and about middle school and high school students. The tone is lighthearted and often self-deprecating.

FORMS:
⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧ (going home) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (club). Modeled on real club names.
